profile.headline: Software Consultant & Full-Stack Django Developer | Founder @ Tiempo | Custom Software & API Integrations for Growing Businesses
profile.summary:
I founded Tiempo Software after leading data integration teams in healthcare tech, where I managed complex HL7 integrations and API connections across more than 50 health systems. That experience taught me how to navigate deep technical complexity while keeping stakeholders aligned, a skill set that translates directly to how I partner with my clients today.

At Tiempo, I combine hands-on engineering with a consultative approach. When you work with me, you get direct collaboration from initial strategy through final implementation. By handling both the architecture and the client communication myself, I ensure projects move efficiently without any dropped context or misaligned expectations.

My core expertise spans custom software development, system integrations, and cloud-based DevOps across AWS, GCP, and DigitalOcean. Because I have spent years managing technical teams and working inside enterprise systems, I understand how to write clean code that serves specific business goals, helping companies solve their operational challenges effectively.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead software development and client delivery for a consultancy serving small businesses through enterprise clients. Provide hands-on technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and architecture through deployment and team training. Clients work with me from the first conversation to launch, which keeps scope, communication, and delivery aligned.
 
Key responsibilities and projects:
 
• Design and build custom Django/Python REST APIs and full-stack web applications
• Deliver enterprise API integrations, including a logistics integration connecting Greater Omaha Packing to McLeod's transportation management system
• Build AI/LLM solutions on DigitalOcean's AI Agent Platform, including a retrieval-augmented knowledge base in OpenSearch that multiple agents draw from, with Google Vision for image and document processing
• Develop data integrations against external systems such as NHTSA vehicle data and Cloudflare's API
• Architect and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and DigitalOcean
• Build and maintain WordPress solutions, including custom themes, plugins, and managed hosting
Train client teams on software adoption and project-management practices
• Build a custom data integration tool to automate flow between GoHighLevel CRM and the JobTread construction estimating and project management platform
positions.insights: Skills: Project Planning · Data Analysis · DigitalOcean · McLeod TMS · NumPy · Mirth Connect · Analytical Skills · Software Architecture · Cloud Infrastructure · Python · Django · Matplotlib · Documentation · REST APIs · Data Analytics · Large Language Models (LLM) · GoHighLevel · WordPress · Solution Architecture · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
• Data Analysis utilizing tools including AWS Athena, AWS Aurora (MySQL), And Python
• Perform in a consultative role, providing best practices and the ability to think out of the box to solve complex data management challenges
• Participate in the initial sales cycle as a technical and Client workflow discovery resource
• Develop customized workflows/processes to enhance Client’s usage and drive adoption of Phynd product(s)
• Understand and communicate Client’s technical requirements with internal development team
• Facilitate testing and validation meetings internally and with Clients
• Serve as key contributor in weekly Client project meetings
• Possess demonstrated ability to create and maintain internal documents, guides, and manuals with attention to fine detail

positions.title: Technical Data Product Manager & QA Manager (Scrum Master)
positions.description:
Responsible for data related improvements using AWS infrastructures in streamlining data pipelines, optimizing work flows, standardizing templates, productizing internal features relating to infrastructure improvements, assisting with data analysis and managing our QA team overseeing company data.

• Pushed and tracked new data features
• Roadmapped main projects for C-Suite executives
• Managed Data QA team and implementation of automation for infrastructure
• Identified inefficiencies with client implementation processes and optimized them to shorten client onboarding time
• Designed and implemented standardized templates and increased technical documentation
• Created and updated various teams with new technical documents, templates, and standards, adopted by management, sales, accounts, and data development teams
• Managed data-related projects using AWS infrastructures to streamline data pipelines, optimize workflows, and standardize templates
• Productized internal features related to infrastructure improvements and assisted with data analysis
• Acted as Scrum Master and Agile coach for 2+ years, using Agile/Scrum (e.g. grooming, planning, review, retrospectives) for daily operations. Had the QA team use Talend to automate data pipelines tests written by ETL team
• Migrated company to Atlassian's Jira and Confluence from a legacy QA tool (CA Rally)

positions.title: Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
• Consulted clients as technical liaison to gather requirements for their integrations
• Provided best fit solutions for client workflows
• Analyzed data sets and communicated them with business analysts and C-Suite execs
• Guided clients through UAT, logged defects, and created technical tickets for data team to resolve
• Built SSO interfaces using SAML 2.0
• Set up VPN connections
• Created and managed small team of developers to acquire and import public data streams

positions.title: Integrations Software Engineer & Data Acquisitions
positions.description:
• Used Mirth Connect (JavaScript) to import and export data streams (e.g Epic, Meditech, Midas, Cactus, and many others)
• Developed suite of server side Python scripts before switching over to solutions via AWS Lambda functions
• Increased data streams counts
• Ensured data was kept up-to-date
• Suggested business logic based on domain knowledge of data

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
• Designed a couple sites using Bootstrap and the Joomla CMS
• Set up and maintained LAMP stack server (Ubuntu)
• Migrated company to HubSpot COS (CMS)
• Created initial infrastructure within HubSpot later adopted by the marketing team
• Developed Tools within HubSpot to complement the marketing team

positions.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
• Member of the Agile Development team composed of onshore and offshore members; participate in the Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, iteration review, and retrospective.
• Translate user stories into working test plans and test cases
• Develop, maintain and organize test cases and automation scripts for web application and APIs
• Must participate in reviewing business requirements and obtain clarifications from the project team.
• Document and Analyze test results to ensure correct functionality and interact with the team for resolution of defects.
Responsible for communicating daily progress, issues, risks and quality metrics
Deliver project assignments on time
Develop subject matter expertise in Phynd’s platform.

positions.title: Assistant Research Scientist
positions.description:
Characterization of the Polymer Poly[(vinylidenefluoride-co-trifluoroethylene] or PVDF-TrFE

• With the aid of a Langmuir-Blodgett Trough and a Brewster Angle Microscope, measured operational properties of the polymers at different molar weights
• Depositions of thin films results sent to German lab for additional analysis
• Results published to the Materials Research Society (MRS) in the Cambridge Journals

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Investigated the prevalence of the daughter isotopes of Radon and their decay curves.  This was an expansion of the EPA's regular protocol that students on campus perform twice a week while measuring alpha-beta levels of filter samples.
• New procedure and research is run in tandem with the EPA's routine without interfering with their analysis.
• Latest results presented in La Crosse, Wisconsin for NCUR 2013.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• "Characterization of Langmuir Films by Brewster Angle Microscopy" - Investigated properties of amphiphiles using a technique which allows the desired data we collect to be viewed exclusively on top of water.  Results presented at NCUR 2012 located at Webber State in Utah.
		
• "Simulate Properties of Ferro-electric Polymers" - Simulated certain properties of materials which possess future applications in data storage with the aid of MATLAB.

• "Spectral Decomposition and Analysis of Sound" - After acquiring sound and converting it to ASCII, analysis of the data was conducted with the aid of Fast Fourier Transforms (FFT's) through MATLAB. The resulting data was used to locate trends with "Pink Noise" properties and to further check its ubiquitous prevalence in nature.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Studied thin films (PVDF-TrFE) to help with the Characterizations of Langmuir Films using Brewster Angle Microscopy, and Langmuir Troughs
• Results presented at 2013 Annual Meeting of the Nebraska Academy of Sciences, Aeronautics and Space Science section

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant (REU)
positions.description:
• Studied thin films (PVDF-TrFE) using a technique known as Brewster Angle Microscopy to help with the Characterizations of Langmuir Films
• Applied the Langmuir-Blodgett method to create depositions of materials in a Langmuir trough
• Analyzed the depositions with an Atomic Force Microscope for indications of nano-mesas. 
• Learned methods of Ellipsometry

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
• Greeted every customer with energy and enthusiasm about technology.
• Skilled in serving and selling to multiple customers.
• Provided customers cutting-edge product and service solutions in a friendly, confident and knowledgeable manner.
• As a bilingual assistant, I managed to connect better with customers who spoke in Spanish
• Maximized my ability to work independently as well as on a team

volunteerExperiences.description: Refurbished and fixed donated bikes with some mechanical issues to the point where they could be donated to kids in need in the Omaha area.

I teach kids how to build and launch rockets. Goal is to make it a multidisciplinary hobby to teach kids about the chemistry, physics, and incorporating Arduino / ESP32 micro-controllers for simple data logging tasks.

publications.title: Investigation of Ferroelectric Polymer Langmuir Film Properties

organizations.name: Omaha Chamber of Commerce
organizations.description: The Greater Omaha Chamber is one of the country’s largest, strongest chambers. We are advocates, catalysts and partners.

organizations.name: Aircraft Owners and Pilot's Association
organizations.description: With hundreds of thousands of members, AOPA is the largest, most influential general aviation association in the world. AOPA has achieved its prominent position through effective advocacy, enlightened leadership, technical competence, and hard work. Providing member services that range from representation at the federal, state, and local levels to legal services, advice, and other assistance, AOPA has built a service organization that far exceeds any other in the aviation community.
